title: John Dee's angelic work led to colonizing America as a New Atlantis
summary: Matthew Brown tells of John Dee's angelic work led to colonizing America as a New Atlantis, about 16th century onward at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it led directly to the colonization of the United States of America and the new Atlantis.

plain: A researcher named Matthew Brown, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, tells a story about John Dee, an English scholar of the 1500s, and his partner Edward Kelley, who said they spoke with angels. Brown says this angel work "led directly" to the colonization of what became the United States, which he describes as a "New Atlantis", a new version of the legendary lost island civilization. If he is right, America's founding grew in part out of contact with nonhuman beings.
